title: CancelOrder
description: Compensation from checkout when the place-order step timed out: make sure the checkout ends with no live order. Cancels the checkout's order if one was placed; otherwise records the cancellation so a late place-order for this checkoutId is answered with orders.order-rejected (reason cancelled). Idempotent per checkoutId. Reply: orders.order-cancelled. Keyed by checkoutId.

reason.description: Why the order is being cancelled: the saga's place-order step timed out.
